text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought the injured Satono Diamond to 
the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much for your 
consideration.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still... I really think that if it's just 
an injury like this, I can still keep 
pushing through.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've finished first aid, would 
you care to go a bit longer...?
choice_data_list: Don't let your guard down, okay?

Shall we give it a try while being 
careful?
Want to give it a try while being careful?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've finished first aid, would 
you care to go a bit longer...?
choice_data_list: Don't let your guard down, okay?

Shall we give it a try while being 
careful?
Want to give it a try while being careful?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's barely any pain. As long as 
I'm careful, it shouldn't be a problem...!
choice_data_list: Let's stop before it gets any worse.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Even a minor injury can 
lead to a serious one.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry... I'll head home and 
keep quiet for today, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though disappointed given how eager she 
had been, Satono Diamond obediently headed 
back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I want to finish today's menu 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Respecting Satono Diamond's wishes, we 
decided to continue training, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, actually... I'm so sorry, I took 
things too lightly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wrapping up training this time for sure, I 
decided to have Satono Diamond take a 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As long as it's light exercise, there's no 
problem at all! Hehe, that's such a 
relief!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was worried, but she didn't seem in 
pain. It looked to be an extremely minor 
injury.
